why: In section 3, item 6, the reader quotes the note "(הערה לבדוק: ...)" under the result box. They say it "looked like a note someone left for themselves" and made them wonder whether the number was final. That says the note looks internal and out of place. Before it, I counted four problems: the one-year fund history, the standing-order price, the foreign-fund line and the European Central Bank rate. The position could be 4 or 6 depending on what counts as a separate problem.
